You can say what you want, but this is the rule.

This isn't cops abusing their power. This is cops using the power they were given.

This is about a system that gives them justification and cover to do pretty much anything they fucking want to in the moment -- up to and including murder -- AND GET AWAY WITH IT AS LONG AS THEY CAN DREAM UP A PLAUSIBLE STORY AFTERWARDS.

It also clearly shows that none of this on the cops' side had anything to do with the law. Period. It's all about their egos and “authority”.

The dipshit that refused to take his foot out of the doorway pretty much says it all.

These guys knew he didn't have a landline, so they knew they weren't even at the right house, and still they pressed the issue again and again like idiots -- not because any law was broken and not because anyone was in danger, and not because they actually cared about fulfilling their obligation to safeguard the safety and welfare of anyone who actually was in danger -- BECAUSE IF THEY DID THEY WOULD HAVE SAID, "HOLY SHIT WE'VE GOT THE WRONG HOUSE! WE NEED TO FIND THE RIGHT ONE BECAUSE THAT CALLER COULD BE IN DANGER!" not be told 50 times to get the fuck out and refuse.

So what were they trying to prevent?

They were trying to prevent him and anyone from overruling them.

The most important thing to a cop in any interaction with a non-cop is to establish authority, gain control and then use that control in any way they see fit at the moment.

Control and maintaining power imbalance is their first priority always. This is drilled into recruits in every academy. "Command presence" is the first level of the use-of-force continuum.

When cops say they feared for their life, the fear started not when any danger was actually present, but as soon as they felt that they had lost control of the situation, their command presence was not being respected. Their orders were not being followed. People had the gall to disrespect and oppose their aggression and “authority”.

Like the guy in the video says, if so little can scare them and put them in fear for their lives, they have no fucking business being cops.
